desc: Feasibility rule: print "No" iff R%2==1 or (R==0 and B%2==1); else "Yes" (justified: each red piece supplies exactly one parity-flipping edge, so R must be even; R=0 reduces to a bipartite blue graph needing even B).

Blue chain mapped by (x,y)->(x+y+1,x-y) (injective), odd/even B variants disjoint from red intermediates and from R1/R2.
Mixed sequence R1, blue chain, R2, red intermediates (side chosen by B parity); edges R1->B1, Bk->R2, R2->inter, inter_last->R1 all verified legal.
R=0 all-blue cycle via orthogonal cycle mapped through T (diagonal moves), requires even B.
OFFSET=1e6 shift keeps coordinates in [1,1e9]; O(sum(R+B)) I/O.
main() reads stdin and writes only the answer to stdout, "Yes"/placement or "No".
